steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1')

steps.name: seam-present
steps.failMessage: window.__updateFlow DEV seam not installed — registerAppServiceWorker() must run before this (main.tsx) and import.meta.env.DEV must be true (it is under `vite dev`).

steps.name: set-downloading
steps.eval: window.__updateFlow.set({ type: 'downloading', done: null, total: null })

steps.name: clear-before-uptodate
steps.note: uptodate/offline/error/reloading are ALTERNATE outcomes of one check, not a real sequence after ready — clear between each so its screenshot isn't cluttered by the previous alternate-outcome toast.

steps.name: set-error
steps.eval: window.__updateFlow.set({ type: 'error', msg: 'The update failed to download — check your connection and try again.' })

steps.name: real-version-json-fetch
steps.eval: window.__realFetchResult = 'pending'; fetch('/version.json', { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => { window.__realFetchResult = t }).catch(e => { window.__realFetchResult = 'ERROR:' + e })
steps.note: REAL network fetch against the running http://localhost:5200/version.json — not a mock. `vite dev` has no build step, so this path 404s/SPA-falls-back rather than serving the built version.json (that file is emitted by vite.config.ts's versionManifestPlugin, apply:'build' only) — documenting that real-environment limit is the point of this step, matching fetchDeployedVersion()'s own try/catch-and-return-null behaviour on exactly this response shape.
